_notes.unit_minutes_source: Best-case routing: bed = head 5 + leg 3 + centre 5 cut minutes (T1.a min across machines); bed panelling 10+4+8 (T1.b min); table panelling 6 + 4x3; bed assembly 25 min best crew (T2.a) + packing 8 (T2.b); table 8 + 5.
_notes.capacity_source: 2 cutting machines x 2400 min (5-day week), 3 panelling machines x 2400, 22 people x 2400 person-min.
_notes.sixth_day: Raise capacity arrays to 2880/8640/63360 for weeks where the optional 6th day is worked.
_notes.demand_conflict: The source DOCX prints week-48 beds = 350; the companion XLSX cell L20 holds 150. Both variants were solved; this file carries the conservative DOCX series.
